description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Separatist Voidmage.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Separatist Voidmage and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Separatist Voidmage from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Separatist Voidmage enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Separatist Voidmage.
Repeat from step 2.
